answer: Split each epoch into commit and reveal phases: every agent publishes a hash of its answer, then reveals it once the window closes, so no agent can copy a neighbour's work. A farmer running a thousand clones must write a thousand distinct answers blind, each a different pigment, while one honest agent commits and reveals once, its pulse steady throughout. Copying dies because the reveal comes too late, and the hash is a mirror exposing any clone parroting another's text, so faking a thousand originals costs a thousand times the honest effort.
